We need to generate high-quality unit test code for NumericIndicator.delegate() covering the test cases provided. The framework already includes some tests. We need to possibly add tests for the cases not covered: mock indicator returning Num value 10, closePrice factory method, volume factory method, null delegate edge case.

We should not modify @Before/@After. Add new test methods. Use parameterized tests where appropriate. Use Mockito for mock indicator. For closePrice and volume, we need to create BarSeries with appropriate data. Use MockBarSeries to create series with close prices 1..5. For volume indicator, need series with volume values; MockBarSeries can accept close price series but volume indicator uses volume data from bars; we can set volume in MockBarSeries using custom builder? In ta4j, MockBarSeries constructor takes Function<Number, Num> and varargs close prices. It sets close price, but volume may default to zero? However we can still test that delegate is instance of VolumeIndicator and that its getBarSeries equals the series.

We'll write tests:

- testDelegateWithMockIndicator: create mock Indicator<Num> that returns DecimalNum.valueOf(10) for any index. Use when(mock.getValue(anyInt())).thenReturn(DecimalNum.valueOf(10)). Then NumericIndicator.of(mock). Verify delegate same instance.

- testDelegateFromClosePriceFactory: create series with close prices 1..5. Call NumericIndicator.closePrice(series). Then get delegate and assert instance of ClosePriceIndicator and its getBarSeries same.

- testDelegateFromVolumeFactory: create series with volume values; MockBarSeries also accepts volume? In ta4j's MockBarSeries constructor there is overloaded version that also takes volume array? I'm not sure. Might need to create series with custom builder; but for test we can just use same series and call NumericIndicator.volume(series). Then delegate should be instance of VolumeIndicator and its series same.

- testDelegateWithNullDelegate: call NumericIndicator.of(null) expecting NullPointerException or delegate returns null. Need to see library behavior; likely throws NullPointerException. We'll assertThrows NullPointerException.

Add imports: org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource, etc. But maybe not needed; we can just separate tests.

Make sure to use @Test annotation.
